tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rgyan sogs yongs rdzogs thugs ka ru/ /gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i lte ba'i g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon a rtsibs bzhir ra dang pa tsa na/ /de las 'od 'phros bdag gzhan mun pa sbyangs/ /rang gi lce steng dhīḥyig nyal thabs la/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i ljags kyi dhīḥyig 'phros/ /ngag gi sgrib sbyangs shes bya rab 'byams shes/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī zhes ci nus dang / /dbugs thang gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ 'jam mgon bla ma 'od phung dmar por zhu/ /rang gi spyi bo nas thim sgo gsum 'dres/ /ka dag gdod ma'i ye shes thugs kyi dbyings/ /kha dog lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gang du'ang 'char ba tshad med sprul pa che/ /bdag sogs sems can kun gyis myur thob shog /gti mug mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma shar/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /byin rlabs char 'bebs dngos grub sprin phung gis/ /'phral yun dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces 'di sa skya pa kun blos/ /sku se ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /bskul don bzhin du gang thon bris/ /mkhas rnams thugs khrel mi gnang zhu// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ dkon mchog la skyabs byang sems bskyed/ /lan gsum sogs ci rigs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng / /rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar/ /phyag bzhi dang po thugs kar ni/ /thal sbyar g.yas gnyis shel phreng dang / /g.yon gnyis pad sdong nor bu bsnams/ /spyan gnyis zhal 'dzum ral cog can/ /rin chen dar gyi rgyan gos mdzes/ /kṛṣ+ṇa'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab/ /rdo rje skyil krung stabs kyis bzhugs/ /de yi thugs kar hrīḥdakar mthar/ /yi ge drug mas bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros bdag dang 'gro drug gi /sdig sbyangs 'phags pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /oṃ ma ṇi ped+ma hūm̐/ /zhes ci nus mthar/ jo bo bdag dang sems can la/

/gnas skabs mthar thug dngos grub stsol/ /dge bas bdag gzhan sgrib byang nas/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog/ //ces pa 'di sa skya pa kun blos/ glo mo phun tshogs sgrol ma'i ngor bris/ me bya zla 5tshes la// ༈ /gsol 'debs srid zhi'i mchog gyur bzhugs// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bsod nams kha ba'i lhun por legs bzhugs shing / /lung rtogs bdag med seng ge'i nga ro can/ /gang de'i ring lugs pad+ma bzhad pa'i tshal/ /bstan 'dzin sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu mkhyen gsal brtse ba'i khur ldan zhing / /mthu stobs nus pas phyogs dus rnam kun tu/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /chos rje snyigs dus dpal mgon la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol mchog /thun mong min pa'i dgongs 'brel mkhas grub che/ /kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge'i gdan sa pa/ /'gran bral phyogs las rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar gsol bas gzhan gnod gzhir bcas bral/ /byams dang snying rje smon 'jug byang sems 'byong / /smin grol bdud rtsi'i ro dang mi 'bral bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bdag cag mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyang / /gnas skabs rgud bral bde dga'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ /sa lam mthar phyin kun mkhyen rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang myur thob srid zhi'i mchog gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan rin po che pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbon rnams nas gsol 'debs 'di bzhin bskul ba ltar/ rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin sbyar ba'o/ /me bya lor/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ spros bral chos dbyings nam mkhar dmigs med kyi/ /thugs rje'i nyi 'od gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /skyabs gnas nam mkha'i nor bus dge legs stsol/

/zhes shis par brjod pa'i tshig nyung ngus sngun bsus te/ de la 'dir rgyal ba rnams ni rgyun chad med par 'gro la rjes chags kyis sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan mngon du mdzad nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ gang 'dul der ston gyis sems can gyi don rgyun chad med par mdzad pa bzhin gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i mgon du bsam bzhin byon pa'i 'od gsal lha'i gdung / mthu chen 'khon gyi rigs 'dzin/ dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi gdung rabs rin po che sngar byon zin pa rnams ni mkhas grub kyi phreng ba bar ma chad pas/ yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du rnam dkar 'phrin las bzang po'i rgyun rgya che mu med du bzhugs pa bzhin/ rgya dar rtse mdo'i gdul bya rnams kyi re ba bskong ba'i phyir gang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa pha ri sgar zhes dang / zu ru sbug ces dgon gnas nas bla grwa rim can gyis 'gro don skyong mu dang / tshong khag lo res kyis 'grim 'grul sogs 'brel lam yod pa bzhin la/ sa phyogs 'dir ni rgya bod 'dus tshogs che zhing sa yul gnyan pas snga thog sa 'gul blos mi 'khyud pa dang / dus phyis me chus nyer 'tshe sogs kyis 'gro rnams nyam thag shar ba de bzhin ma bzod par/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes kun la phan pa'i lhag bsam zol med du yod pa ngos nas pha ri sgar dgon pa gsar bzhengs su bzhugs rgyu'i sman sku dpal sa skya'i rje btsun rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan te gong ma lnga dang / snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen/

mkhas grub 'gran zla kun bral 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams bcas bla sku dang / 'byung 'dul/ gur zhal 'khor bcas/ nor lha bcas kyi sman sku dang / pha sgar zur sbug gnyis kyi rten gtsor/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi sku zangs gser las grub pa 'di rnams bzhengs shing nang bzhugs ring bsrel rnam bzhi srid na dkon pa sa lugs nyid gtso cher bzhugs pa'i 'dod gsol bstan 'gro spyi la dgos pa dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin dang / dmigs bsal phyogs de'i snod bcud yongs la go ba nged rang nas gsar rtsom gsham gsal ltar bzhugs pa 'di rnams la/ ngos nas rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga lag len rnam par dag pas byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i dam ye dbyer med ro gcig tu bgyis pa bzhin gsol ba btab na mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med du stsol nges pa yin pas dad dang dam tshig ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams nas dgon gnas rten bla grwa bcas pa mchod yul du bzung ba'i zhabs tog bsnyen bkur yang dag mdzad 'tshal/ 'di na mthong bas yid can dang ba 'dren/ /tshul bzhin bsten na dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs/ /yid bzhin dbang rgyal lta bu'i rten rnams la/ /phyag mchod gsol 'debs re ba don ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas dam pa nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis dar rtse'i mdo'i pha sgar zur sbug dgon rnam gnyis su bzhugs rgyu'i rten gyi dkar chag nyung ngu don tshang du bris// ༈ /'dod gsol la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes gdul bya so so'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par gyur pa/ thun mong mchog gi dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /spyir sems can thams cad dang khyad par rgya dar rtse mdo snod bcud kun la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

'dir skyes pa'i sems can rnams dang byes nas yong ba'i 'gro ba ser skya pho mo dud 'gro gzugs can gzugs med dang bcas pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa dang / da lta gsog bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na gsog par 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga la sogs pa sgo gsum gyis bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag pa dang / slar yang de lta bu mi bgyid par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ las ngan de dag gi 'bras bu ngan song sogs srid pa'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' myong dgos pa rnams las myur du thar par mdzad du gsol/ lung pa 'di nyid du sa g.yo ba/ chu 'khrugs pa/ me 'bar ba/ rlung nag 'tshub pa/ lce 'bab pa/ nad rims sna tshogs/ lo tog nyes pa/ 'khrugs pa sogs kyis snod bcud yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bas/ sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa skyed par byed pa de dag las rnam pa kun tu bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad du gsol/ gzhis byes 'gro ba thams cad tshe ring nad med bde skyid longs spyod ma tshang pa med pa'i 'tsho bas dus 'da' zhing bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos min rgyud la skyes nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che so so'i skal pa dang 'tshams par nyams su blangs te mngon mtho nges legs myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ༈ /na mo gu ru bi ru pa la ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las thams cad gdul bya so so'i mos ngo dang mthun par stsol phyir bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po rdo rje 'chang bsod nams rin chen gyi zhal snga nas dang /

bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha'i mtshan can dang / bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang legs pa'i mtshan can sogs bdag la bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs rin po che rnams nas mdo sngags rig gnas sogs zab rgyas chos tshul gsan pa'i rgya bal bod kyi mkhas grub ji snyed byon pa rnams dang / ngor rdzong gong tshar sogs bstan 'dzin mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams dang / de dag gi thugs nyams su bstar zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog zhi rgyas dbang drag gi rnam rol du ston pa rnams dang / bla ma dam pa de rnams dang dbyer ma mchis kyang ldog pa tha dad sku dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams dang / 'dod dgu stsol ba'i dbang nor lha tshogs rnams dang bcas pas/ spyir snod bcud thams cad dang / bye brag dpal sa skya pa la ltos pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas kyang rgya dar rtse mdo'i pha ri sgar pas mtshon yul gru zhing khang nor rdzas chos sde dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang bcas bsrung zhing skyong ba dang byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas 'gal rkyen bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing / mthun rkyen 'phral yun dge ba'i 'dod smon mtha' dag yid bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dus gsum dge 'bras rnam dag la smin nas dus rtag tu bde skyid kho nas 'tsho ba dang / dge ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtse 'dzam gling phun tshogs dpal 'bar nas/

sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// ༈ phur pa'i 'dod gsol bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po ste rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ lha dregs ldan chos skyong / klu klu rgyal 'jog po/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ mi li tsa bī dri med/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bi ma la mi tra/ shī lā mañdzu/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs rigs 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ 'khon ston klu dbang bsrung ba sku mched nas dkon mchog rgyal po'i bar du byon pa rnams dang / dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ de'i dbon brgyud ye shes 'byung gnas/ bdag nyid chen po bzang por dpal/ de las 'phros pa'i gzhi thog bla brang / rin chen sgang bla brang / lha khang bla brang / dus mchod bla brang ste khag bzhi'i gdung rabs las/ dus mchod pa'i gras rtse thog bla brang pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen yab sras dbon brgyud zam ma chad par byon pa dang / gzhan yang zhal slob kha'u pa/ bu lung pa lo mchog dga' ldan pa/ gan pa ba/ gzhan yang dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen sogs brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa rnams dang / gzhan yang rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sgyu 'phrul brgyud pa'i bla ma/ phar phyin theg pa'i brgyud pa rnams dang / dam pa rigs brgya/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ 'phrin las phur pa/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs/ khyad par du yang lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/

hūm̐ ka ra/ rnam par rgyal ba/ dbyug pa sngon po/ gshin rje gshed/ mi g.yo mgon po/ rta mgrin rgyal po/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ stobs po che ste khro bo bcu/ sgra 'byin/ sgeg mo/ sder mo/ dur khrod/ gtun khung / gtum mo/ mda' snyems/ sgra mdzad/ gsod ma/ rig byed de khro mo bcu/ phag stag g.yag sha gzig byi la/ ce spyang / seng ge dred/ dom/ gdong can te phyag brnyan bcu/ rmig bu/ bya rgod/ bya rog khwa ta/ 'ug pa/ spu shud/ khra/ pha wang / sre mong / byi ba'i gdong can te phra man bcu/ spu shud/ bya rog srin bya/ khra mgo can te sgo ma bzhi/ badz+ra kī la ya/ bud+dha kī la ya/ rat+na kī la ya/ pad+ma kī la ya/ karma kī la ya te sras mchog lnga bcas rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla/ bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ mi srin mo/ tshangs ma/ 'khrugs mo/ dbang mo/ mjug sred ma/ gzhon nu ma/ nag mo chen mo/ dmar mo/ bdud rtsi ma/ zhi ba mo/ be con mo/ srin mo/ za ba mo/ dmar ser chen mo/ dga' ba mo/ myos ma/ gcig spyod ma/ yid 'phrog ma/ grub mo/ rlung mo/ bum rna/ gsod byed ma/ me mo/ phag mo/ rgan byed mo/ sna chen mo/ chu lha mo/ ser nag chen mo ste dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad/ re ma ti/ re ma ṭa/ re ma dza/ re ma dzu ste bdag nyid ma bzhi/ spyang ki/ 'phar ba/ wa/ khyi gdong ste shā na ma bzhi/ spyin byin/ ya byin/ bse byin/ phag byin te sa bdag ma bzhi/ gau rī/ tsau ri/ pra mo hā/ bet+ta lī/ puk+ka sī/ ghasma ri/ sme sha nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa li ste gnas ma brgyad/ seng / stag wa/ khyi/ bzhad/ ngur bya/ khwa ta/ 'ug pa'i gdong ste yul ma brgyad/ stag phag dred/ spyang ste sgo ma bzhi/ kun drag ma/ g.ya' ma skyong / kun bzang ma/ bgegs kyi gtso ste bdud mo bzhi/ g.yu bun ma/ dpal gyi yum/ rlung mo/ grags mo/ rgyal ste gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ bod khams skyong / sman gcig ma/ g.yar mo bsil/ gzugs legs ma ste sman mo bzhi sogs mdor na rtsa gsum mchog gsum skyabs gnas thams cad dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas dpal sa skya pa chen po drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa kun dga' blo gros/

rigs sras dbang sdud snying po/ e waṃ bzang po ste zhal ngo rnam pa gsum/ sku mched rje btsun ma dbon mo bcas dang bdag 'chi med dpal 'byor bzang mo pha ma spun ltos bcas thams cad kyi brgyud byin gyis brlabs nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol/ brtse bas dgongs shig thugs rjes gzigs shig nus mthus srungs shig byang chub ma thob bar skyabs gnas re sa gzhan na med do/ /myur du rjes su bzung du gsol/ 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul bye bas gangs can 'dir/ /mdo rgyud man ngag chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /grangs med 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad nas kyang / /'khor ba ji srid gnas par bzhugs su gsol/ /ngag dbang kun la dga' bde'i dpal ster mkhas/ /snyan pa'i grags pas yongs khyab sa skya pa'i/ /gdung sogs bdag gi lus las sgyu 'phrul char/ /rgyal ba bltams ltar gegs med don mang shog /gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed pa'i/ /sprul pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun chad med pa yang / /bdag nas ma 'ongs srid mtha'i bar 'byon shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gdung rabs mchog /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /de srid rgyun chad med par shog /mkhas btsun bzang ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs kun/ /zhabs pad brtan cing bzhed dgongs mthar phyin nas/ /bstan 'gro kun la 'phral yun phan bde'i sgo/ /brgya phrag 'byed pa'ang bdag nas rim 'byon shog /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu dge ba byed par shog /mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ༈ /chos grags kyi sku'i 'dod gsol bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ lnga bdo'i dpal mgon bdag cag ston pa yi/ /bstan pa dag par bsgrub phyir bsam bzhin du/ /lho phyogs rgyal dbang gtsug nor mu stegs rigs/ /legs 'khrungs gzhon nu sgra mkhan de la 'dud/ /zhang po gzhon nu legs ldan gyis bskrad pas/ /mu stegs mthar mdzad nang pa'i bstan la byon/ /dharmā kirti'i mtshan 'chang dbang phyug sder/ /tshad ma'i gzhung gsan slob dpon las lhag 'dud/ /slob dpon grub mtha' 'khrul 'byin bka' gnang thob/ /grangs can gsang tshig thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis mkhyen/ /rtsod la zla med dril bsgrags phal cher bros/ /do zlar 'os rnams tshar bcad de la 'dud/ /stobs ldan me tog rgyas pa'i sgo drung du/ /mkhas pa'i dril bsgrags phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ /nga min su zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ /dpal ldan chos grags snyan dbyangs bsgrags la 'dud/ /sbyin bdag de rgyus rab byed sde bdun dang / /rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i 'grel bshad sogs/ /du ma'i gam du phyin tshe phrag dog gis/ /khyi mjug btags kyang ngo mtshar gsal bstan 'dud/ /lung rigs thugs rje'i thog mda' log 'dren dgra/ /rmad byung byin rlabs chu rgyun skye dgu'i gnyen/ /rgyal bas lung bstan mkhas grub rgya mtsho yi/ /dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa de la 'dud/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel du mas 'jim bzang ni/ /bzo rig mkhas pa'i lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor las/ /gang gi snang brnyan rgya gar paṇa chen dbyibs/ /chos dbyings me long mdangs can de la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas shes rab ral gris gti mug gcod/ /phyag g.yon bdag med sgra sgrogs rnam 'grel gzhung / /'gro la mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin stsol ba'i phyag /mtha' gnyis gnon pa'i phyed krung can la 'dud/ /kun rmongs rgol gzugs kun dkris kun 'khrugs mdangs/ /yang dag bstan la lhur len 'dud pa'i dbyibs/ /'gro rnams de lta'i dpal la 'god do zhes/

/dge slong cha lugs mdzes pas spras la 'dud/ /don dam rigs bdag paṇa zhwa rtse ring ni/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho phyir gyen du bsgrengs/ /spobs pa'i gdengs ldan zhwa lag rlung bskyod tshul/ /rnam par brjid pa'i dpal 'dzin de la 'dud/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom drwa ba yi/ /rgyar chud 'khrul pa'i gzhung lugs tshar gcod pa'i/ /rnam dag rig gzhung 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs myong rig par smra ba khyed 'drar shog /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rngog lo ches/ /dang por bsgyur mod 'jam mgon sa skya pa/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan gang gis 'gyur mdzad pa'i/ /rnam dag bshad pa'i rgyun 'di cher rgyas shog /'jam mgon bla ma'i don gyi dgongs pa ni/ /'khrul med legs mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs/ /legs pa'i blo gros ngag dbang chos grags rje'i/ /lugs 'dzin blo gsal rgya mtsho cher rgyas shog /de la brten nas rgyal ba'i ring lugs las/ /phyir phyogs log smra kun gyi ro 'dzin snying / /tshal par bkas nas legs bshad 'chi med bcud/ /'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel kun cher rgyas shog /blo dang dbang ming e thog 'chang ba las/ /rigs lam gzhung lugs phyogs bcur rab 'phel nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i ring lugs rnam dag gis/ /'khrul med lam bzang ston 'di cher rgyas shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos grags sprul/ /dpal ldan gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen de'i/ /dpal ldan bka' srol dri med nyin mo'i mgon/ /dpal ldan 'od brgya 'gog med cher rgyas shog /ces 'di sa skya'i gdung gi mchog /dbang sdud snying pos chos grags sku/ /legs bzhengs rnam 'grel gzhung 'dzin ched/ /'dod gsol gang de kun blos dge/ ༈ /hūm̐ skal bzang rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal po yi/ /gnyis med ye shes thugs las sprul pa yi/ /mi zad 'bar ba'i khro bo dud kha che/ /rdo rje dbyug pas keg 'tshub 'joms pa'i gshed/

/sri can g.yul las rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gnyis med bsrung ba'i 'khor lo me 'od 'bar/ /sbyin bdag gnod pa'i keg sri gdug rtsub kun/ /dmigs med me dpung 'bar ba'i klong bsregs nas/ /keg ngan g.yul las rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /shākya'i rgyal po gsang sngags rig sngags mthus/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor chos nyid gdod nas dag /chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden mthu yis/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag gnod 'tshe'i nad gdon dang / /bar chad mi mthun phyogs gyur thams cad dang / /khyad par lo keg zla keg zhag keg dang / /za keg che sri chung sri dar sri dang / /dur sri nad sri god sri phung sri dang / /rgyal sri dgra sri gdon gyi sri la sogs/ /keg sri'i gnod pa mtha' dag dgra bgegs kyi/ /steng du sgyur cig zlog cig ma ra ya// //'di yang sa skya pa kun blos rang gzhan gyi keg ngan bzlog phyir bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ phyag rgyan sogs yongs rdzogs thugs ka ru/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
